system.description:
Narrows existing wards to a single Tradition, Art or Work in exchange for much stronger protection against it.

Spell. Sorcerous Aegis: Formidable (12) Cunning. Strengthen a ward already protecting you against one Tradition, Art or Work; it stops protecting against anything else.

Ritual. Alignment: Rite of Alignment: Challenging (9) Knowledge, 10 minutes. Invocation: Formidable (12) Cunning, 50 minutes. Unleashing: Hard (15) Will. The Rite of Calibration adjusts existing wards without a price.

Art of Warding — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 105.
system.resonances: None (spell), or rare ingredients symbolic of what is defended against (5 gold pieces, rituals).
